value.message:
In this tool, view all security key performance indicators in a list or dashboard organized by category. Create a custom dashboard made up of all security metrics that are most important to you and your security needs for easy visibility.

We'll go through some of the high level features included in this product.
How to get the most value from Security metrics?

#1

Customize your experience by adding your most important metrics to a dashboard to fit your needs

#2

View all security metrics in a single list or by category

#3

Visualize metrics as data visualizations and trends over time for the most insight
In addition to the common practices above, the Security center learning page has many additional resources such as functional guides to help gain value from the security tools offered. Learn more.
